_readme: Endpoints exempt from a tuned rate limit, each with the reason. `npm run check:rate-limits` fails when an anon-callable RPC or an Edge Function is neither limited nor listed here. Prefer adding a rule to app_private.request_rate_rules (see 20261022120000_api_request_rate_limits.sql). Everything listed here still falls under the '*' default cap (anon 120/min per IP, signed-in 300/min per user) because that cap covers every POST route.

anonRpcs.can_read_author_content: Row-level-security helper; cheap indexed lookup. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_display_image_url: Immutable string helper used by views; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_menu_is_displayable: Immutable boolean helper used by views; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_raw_cursor: Immutable cursor encoder used by the paged reads; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_raw_cursor_value: Immutable cursor decoder used by the paged reads; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_url_is_delivery_app: Immutable string helper; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.catalog_venue_menu_priority_score: Pure scoring helper used by search ordering; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.dish_is_sold_out: Row-level-security / view helper; cheap lookup. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.food_cred_daily_cap: Immutable lookup of a configured number; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.food_cred_default_points: Immutable lookup of a configured number; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.food_cred_level_index: Immutable lookup of a configured number; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.merchant_can_manage_venue: Row-level-security helper that returns false for anon; cheap. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.merchant_normalize_availability_flag: Immutable string helper; no table access. Default cap applies.
anonRpcs.merchant_outlet_matches_catalog_link: Row-level-security helper; cheap indexed lookup. Default cap applies.
